senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; שבס, cmp. שָׁבַשׁ; cmp. b. h. שְׂרוֹךְ a. שָׂרַךְ)band, esp. (של סבכה) ש׳ metal (or woolen) band with which the hair-net is fastened.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 5:15">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. V, 15</cite> <he>ש׳ של שבכה טמא וכ׳</he> a net-band is susceptible of uncleanness for itself, because one may (detach and) fit it for another net.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 5:16">Ib. 16</cite> <he>ומשום חיבורי ש׳ וכ׳</he> but (gold foils and plates) used as fastenings of a hair-band are susceptible of uncleanness.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 28:10">Kel. XXVIII, 10</cite> <he>ש׳ שלה</he> the band of the net.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:11">Neg. XI, 11</cite>. Sifra Sh’mini, ch. VII, Par. 8 <he>שָׁבִיץ של סבכה</he>; ib. ch. XI, Par. 10 <he>שביס וכ׳</he> a woolen net-band.
Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ bot. (ref. to שביסים, Is. III, 18) braided bands (v. סִלְבּוֹנַיָּא) כמה דאת אמר ש׳ של סבכה as you say, shabis of the hair-net.
